conclusions.claim: No family satisfies G0-G4 and Holm-adjusted family-vs-B1 p<0.05.
conclusions.evidence: Both min-max and ordinal counterfactuals have fully_eligible_families=[] and winner=NONE.

conclusions.claim: PGM is the strongest empirical family by observed OOF delta_vs_B1 ranking.
conclusions.evidence: PGM > PCRR > ASR > CSRC under both interpretations; PGM mean delta=0.04535, CI crosses zero, raw p=0.06226, Holm p=0.24902.

conclusions.claim: PCRR shows alignment-grounded signal but not full scientific support.
conclusions.evidence: G3 passes historically and ordinally; G2/G4 fail and Holm is non-significant.

conclusions.claim: CSRC is the weakest empirical direction in this study.
conclusions.evidence: Last under both rankings; G1-G4 fail historically; ordinal FOLD_1 changes but remains ineligible.

conclusions.claim: ASR is conservative on negative-risk capture but not a supported winner.
conclusions.evidence: R_neg_delta CI is below zero, while G4 fails because C_AP/R_pos do not both pass; ordinal FOLD_2 changes.

conclusions.claim: PCRR is the strongest research-value direction.
conclusions.evidence: Historical score ranks PCRR first, but the score has S2 design/implementation defects and is not certified as robustness.
